title: 12.7 Modeling with Surface Area and Volume

icans: I can find and use density.
I can compare the surface areas and volumes of similar solids.
I can find the box with the least surface area for a given volume.

vocab: the __________ of matter that an object has in a given unit of volume: mass ÷ volume
two solids of the same type with equal ratios of ________________ linear measures

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Discovery: same metal, different cubes

blocks.p: Three aluminum cubes. Fill in the table.
When the edge is multiplied by 2, the surface area is multiplied by ______ and the volume by ______.

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

blocks.stem: A metal block is 2 cm by 3 cm by 5 cm and has a mass of 237 grams. Find its density.
A copper cylinder has a radius of 1 cm and a height of 5 cm. Copper’s density is 8.96 g/cm³. Find the mass of the cylinder. Round to the nearest hundredth.

notes: Similar solids: with scale factor k, the surface areas are in the ratio _______________ and the volumes are in the ratio _______________.

blocks.stem: Two similar prisms have a scale factor of 3 : 5. The smaller has a surface area of 90 ft² and a volume of 54 ft³. Find the surface area and volume of the larger.
Two similar cylinders have volumes of 64π and 216π. Find the scale factor and the ratio of their surface areas.

notes: Least surface area: for a given volume, the box with the least surface area is a _______________.

blocks.stem: Which box with a volume of 64 in.³ has the least surface area: 4 by 4 by 4, 2 by 4 by 8, or 1 by 8 by 8?
A block has a volume of 125 cm³ and a mass of 340 g. Find its density.
Two similar cones have a scale factor of 1 : 4. The smaller has a volume of 12 cm³. Find the volume of the larger.

tickets.stem: An object has a mass of 90 g and a volume of 36 cm³. Find its density.
Two similar solids have a scale factor of 1 : 2. The smaller has a surface area of 20. Find the surface area of the larger.
A box must hold 27 in.³. What dimensions give the least surface area, and what is that surface area?
